gen-gf-gugi-gf-kadwa: Kadwa reads as a classic serif with a tall x-height and curves that stay open at the ends. Gugi sits above it with a marker-like single-width stroke, so the page moves between bold plainness and bookish detail.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noticia-text: Lowercase letters that nearly reach the capitals give Gugi a distinctive, upright stance. Noticia Text follows as a classic serif with generous entry strokes into its curves and big lowercase bodies, which makes extended reading feel literary and dignified.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-pridi: Distinctive in its marker-drawn plainness, Gugi leads with open terminals and curves that match its stems exactly. Pridi, a classic serif, adds refined small letters.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-scope-one: Gugi has no hairlines anywhere in its alphabet, just one bold, constant line with open-cut terminals. And Scope One, a serif with stubby ascenders and a big x-height, gives that sturdiness a traditional, refined partner.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-slabo-13px: Blueprint boldness, then bookish calm. Slabo 13px, a classic serif with large open counters in its a, e and s, keeps a long page dignified, and Gugi's constant line makes a strong opening beside it.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-suwannaphum: Gugi brings a distinctive, stress-free bold line, with tall lowercase nearly matching its capitals. Suwannaphum, a text serif with a wide-open c and high x-height, feels dignified and editorial beside it.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-kiwi-maru: Ruler-straight and bold, Happy Monkey has wide gaps in its e. Kiwi Maru, a text serif with ringlike o shapes and generous letterspace, handles the quieter, editorial work of the body.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-gf-stint-ultra-expan: Stint Ultra Expanded floats each character apart, with open counters and a pipe-cleaner feel. Happy Monkey's ruler-straight, bold line makes a striking partner for that authoritative serif.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-epunda-s: Ascenders that barely clear the x-height give Love Ya Like A Sister a level, expressive beat. Yet Epunda Slab, a dignified serif with a gaping c and tall rounded lowercase, carries the quieter reading.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-fauna-on: Fauna One has a tall middle band and shallow ascenders. Give it a little extra size, since its generous e entry rewards room, while Love Ya Like A Sister stays expressive with stress-free curves.
